command: set -e; old=$(pgrep -f '[r]un_free_evidence_forge.py' | tr '\n' ' ' || true); echo OLD=$old; for p in $old; do kill -KILL "$p" || true; done; for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 1; new=$(pgrep -f '[r]un_free_evidence_forge.py' | tr '\n' ' ' || true); if [ -n "$new" ] && [ "$new" != "$old" ]; then echo NEW=$new; echo HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); sleep 4; cat /artifacts/clay-entityos-swarm/forge/STATUS.json 2>/dev/null || true; exit 0; fi; done; echo FORGE_RESTART_TIMEOUT; exit 2
